t: Does the hillside's rock ever read as stone, or is the procedural slope-blend a ceiling to accept?
d: Five real rounds — three on colour/value, two on height/relief, one full order of magnitude apart in amplitude — with real measured movement on every lever and zero movement in a blind critic's verdict across all five. Clears when you look at shots/hillside/dome-overview.png and either accept the read or say in your own words what's actually wrong.

t: Is grandpas-house-route.png's “flanking” read worth further iteration, or a placement-density limit to accept?
d: Five rounds fixed genuine mechanisms (clump straddling, stray placement, oversized clump radius); two rounds that added density made the same frame measurably worse, for a now-understood reason. Clears when you look at grandpas-house-route.png and say it's fine, or what's actually wrong, in your own words.

t: The square-convergence “unmotivated dark patch” is identified but not fixed — same open question as the route above
d: Direct pixel measurement found the real cause: pure-path pixels average luma 130, pure-grass pixels average luma 67 — ordinary material contrast, not a rendering defect. Fixing it trades against the path's own feathered-edge design. Clears when you accept the current read or name the tradeoff you want.

d: Four blind-judge rounds called all three previewed starters “an asset preview, not a hero character portrait.” The only lever is a roster-wide material/lighting pass — no new meshes are permitted at any credit balance. Clears when you say whether a roster-wide pass is worth commissioning, and if so, whose scope it joins.
